backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profile management (Junior/Senior roles), doubt posting by Juniors, answer posting by Seniors with attachments, rating system, leaderboard with points tracking, and authorization via mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the "Enable Senior users to answer doubts posted by Junior users" feature is implemented in AnswerForm.tsx with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of all frontend files including components for authentication, doubts, answers, ratings, leaderboard, and React Query hooks for backend interactions.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors, including sidebar, chart, and UI component styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component managing authentication state with Internet Identity, showing login screen when unauthenticated or router with doubts, doubt detail, and leaderboard routes when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/AnswerCard.tsx: Card component displaying answer details including responder profile, text, rating stars, downloadable notes/video attachments, and interactive rating input for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AnswerForm.tsx: Form component for Senior users to submit answers with text explanation, optional document notes (PDF/DOC, max 10MB), and optional video (MP4/WebM, max 50MB) with file validation and upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AnswersList.tsx: List component fetching and displaying all answers for a specific doubt with loading skeletons, error handling, and empty state messaging.
frontend/src/components/DoubtCard.tsx: Displays a single doubt as a clickable card with author info, timestamp, description, and optional image attachment. Navigates to the doubt detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/DoubtForm.tsx: Form component for posting new doubts with a text description and optional image upload. Shows upload progress and handles image preview with removal functionality.
frontend/src/components/DoubtsFeed.tsx: Fetches and displays all doubts in reverse chronological order using DoubtCard components. Shows loading skeletons, error alerts, and empty state.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with header (logo, navigation, user profile, login button), main content area, and footer. Conditionally shows RoleSetupModal for authenticated users without profiles.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardTable: Displays a ranked table of users by points with special styling for top 3 positions. Each row shows rank icons, user avatar/name, and point badges.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity authentication with login/logout functionality. Clears query cache on logout and manages login state with disabled states during authentication.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Landing page for unauthenticated users featuring hero section, three feature cards (Ask Doubts, Share Knowledge, Earn Recognition), and login button.
frontend/src/components/RatingInput.tsx: Interactive star rating component for rating answers. Shows success message after rating is submitted and prevents duplicate ratings.
frontend/src/components/RatingStars.tsx: A reusable star rating component that displays 1-5 stars, supports both readonly display and interactive rating selection with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/RoleSetupModal.t: A modal dialog for first-time user onboarding that collects the user's name and role (Junior or Senior) and saves their profile using the useSaveCallerUserProfile hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDoubts.ts: React Query hook that fetches all doubts from the backend actor, returning an array of Principal-Doubt tuples.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAnswersForDoubt: React Query hook that fetches all answers for a specific doubt ID, returning an array of Principal-Answer tuples.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile from the backend, with special handling for loading states and actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetLeaderboard.ts: React Query hook that fetches the leaderboard data containing user rankings and statistics.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserProfile.ts: React Query hook that fetches a specific user's profile by their Principal ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/usePostAnswer.ts: React Query mutation hook for posting an answer to a doubt with text, notes, and video attachments, invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePostDoubt.ts: React Query mutation hook for creating a new doubt with description and optional attachment, invalidating the doubts list on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateAnswer.ts: React Query mutation hook for rating an answer, invalidating both the answers list and leaderboard queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving the current user's profile, invalidating the currentUserProfile query on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors using an orange/amber color scheme for the Askin application.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/DoubtDetailPage.tsx: Page component that displays a single doubt with its details, allows seniors to post answers via AnswerForm, and shows all answers in AnswersList with navigation back to the doubts list.
frontend/src/pages/DoubtsPage.tsx: Main doubts page displaying a hero banner, recent doubts feed, and a sidebar that shows either a doubt form for juniors or an informational message for seniors.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Leaderboard page showing top seniors ranked by points, with a header explaining the point system (+5 for answers, +1-5 bonus for ratings).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended theme settings, typography and animation plugins, and custom keyframes for accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for Askin Q&A app, documenting features, requirements, and architectural notes about the senior/junior role system and doubt posting workflow.
